d: Launch Your Career in AI & Enterprise Software Sales
Representing: Kompetenza | MaxAccelerate AI | DataMax AI
Location: Dubai, UAE – International Sales Opportunities
Initial Position: Independent Sales Partner – Commission Only
Career Progression: Salaried Account Executive + Commission
Account Executive OTE: USD $100,000–$250,000 per annum
Typical Development Period: 3–6 months, depending on individual performance
From Real Estate Sales to the Future of AI
You've learned how to sell high-value property. Now learn how to sell the technology transforming global businesses.

MaxAccelerate Ventures is launching its AI Sales Academy, an exciting career transition opportunity for ambitious real estate sales professionals looking to enter the rapidly growing world of artificial intelligence, enterprise software, CRM and SaaS.
We're taking inspiration from the real estate industry: an entrepreneurial, performance-driven model where successful sales professionals build their own opportunities and are rewarded for results.
A structured pathway from independent, commission-based sales partner to a fully salaried Account Executive position within our group of technology companies.
You don't need previous AI or software sales experience.
We'll provide the product training, mentorship, technical expertise and commercial support to help you make the transition.
You bring the sales experience, ambition and determination.
This is not a salaried position when you first join.
All successful applicants initially join the programme as Independent Sales Partners, operating on a commission-only basis.
Already hold a valid UAE residence visa.
Have the appropriate independent work authorisation, freelance permit or business licence for the activities you will undertake.
Be legally entitled to provide independent sales or referral services in the UAE.
Be financially independent and able to support yourself without a guaranteed salary during the initial stage.
Be comfortable operating under an independent commercial partner agreement rather than an employment contract.
MaxAccelerate Ventures will not provide visa sponsorship or a basic salary during the Independent Sales Partner stage.
The Academy is designed for individuals who already understand the entrepreneurial nature of commission-led sales.
As an independent partner, you'll have the flexibility to develop your own sales opportunities, supported by our products, technical specialists and optional training resources.
Your Route to a Salaried Account Executive Career
Our objective is to identify and develop talented sales professionals who can progress into permanent Account Executive positions across our group.
q: Residential and commercial real estate sales.
You should be confident in prospecting, relationship building, negotiation and closing deals.
You should also be self-motivated, financially independent, professional and eager to learn about technology.
r: Successfully complete the Academy's commercial and product competency assessments.
Generate and close your first qualifying customer deal.
Demonstrate the commercial skills and professionalism required for an Account Executive position.
Once these milestones have been achieved and your promotion has been formally approved, you'll be offered a paid Account Executive position with a monthly basic salary plus commission.
This is the point at which your salaried employment begins, following the required employment authorisation and contractual arrangements.
There is no fixed promotion deadline.
We anticipate that successful candidates may typically progress within 3–6 months, although some may achieve this sooner and others may take longer.
Progression is based on individual performance, not time served. Promotion and employment are not guaranteed.
Three Technology Companies. One Career Opportunity.
As a member of the MaxAccelerate Ventures AI Sales Academy, you'll gain exposure to three innovative technology businesses.
Kompetenza helps businesses improve sales performance, automate operations and expand internationally.
Solutions include Salesforce CRM, AI-powered lead generation, go-to-market technology, Corporate Services Cloud, EOR Cloud, Salesforce Nearshore and industry-specific software.
MaxAccelerate AI – Enterprise AI & Intelligent Automation
MaxAccelerate AI helps organisations adopt artificial intelligence across their business operations.
Solutions include enterprise AI agents, intelligent automation, AI-powered business applications and technology transformation services.
DataMax AI – AI for Enterprise Asset Management
DataMax AI develops advanced AI solutions for organisations managing complex physical assets and infrastructure.
Solutions include AI-powered maintenance analytics, private enterprise AI, intelligent applications and integrations with Enterprise Asset Management platforms such as IBM Maximo.
You focus on building relationships and identifying opportunities. Our technical specialists support the solution demonstrations and delivery.
What You'll Learn at the AI Sales Academy
Learn the fundamentals of artificial intelligence, enterprise software, CRM and the solutions offered across our group.
Develop an understanding of customer challenges, commercial value propositions and enterprise technology sales.
Begin independently developing qualified opportunities using your existing sales experience and professional network.
You'll have access to agreed sales enablement resources, CRM tools, marketing materials, product specialists and technical support.
Work towards converting your first qualifying opportunity into a signed customer contract.
We'll support you with product knowledge, technical demonstrations, proposal development and commercial guidance.
After your first qualifying deal and successful Academy assessment, you can be considered for a salaried Account Executive position.
Upon formal appointment, you'll receive a basic salary, commission plan, performance targets and an ongoing career development pathway.
Account Executive OTE: USD $100,000–$250,000 per annum
Our ambition is to create an environment where successful sales professionals can build highly rewarding careers in enterprise technology.
The potential earning range depends on your sales level, experience, target market, deal values, market conditions and achievement of agreed revenue targets.
OTE means On-Target Earnings and includes basic salary plus potential commission. It is not a guaranteed income or a promise of earnings.
During the initial Independent Sales Partner stage, remuneration is commission-only on qualifying business generated under your commercial partner agreement.
x: Why Join the MaxAccelerate Ventures AI Sales Academy?
You're not just changing industries. You're building a new career.
A structured transition into AI and enterprise software sales.
Product training across three technology businesses.
Access to experienced technology and commercial professionals.
Technical support for customer presentations and proposals.
Access to agreed sales enablement tools and resources.
Commission opportunities during the independent partner stage.
A performance-based route into a salaried Account Executive position.
Long-term career development into senior enterprise sales and leadership roles.
Who This Opportunity Is Not For
We want to be completely transparent.
This programme is not suitable for individuals who
Require a guaranteed monthly salary immediately.
Need the group to sponsor their residence visa during the initial partner stage.
Do not have appropriate legal authorisation to operate independently.
Are unable to financially support themselves while building their sales pipeline.
Are looking for a traditional entry-level employment position.
We are looking for entrepreneurial sales professionals who are prepared to invest in their future and have the ambition to build a career in one of the world's fastest-evolving industries.
From Real Estate to AI Sales.
Three Technology Companies. One Career Opportunity. Your Performance Determines Your Progression.
Join the MaxAccelerate Ventures AI Sales Academy and take your first step towards becoming an enterprise technology Account Executive.

To apply, please provide your CV, a summary of your sales achievements, your current UAE visa and independent work-authorisation status, and a short explanation of why you want to transition into AI and software sales.
